chapterInfo.content:
7
1Meresa Israel yadeɛ yi,
na Efraim amumuyɛ ne Samaria
nnebɔne reda adi;
na wɔdi atorɔ,
na owifoɔ bubu ba mu,
akwanmukafoɔ asafo nso fom fa wɔ mmorɔno so.
2Na wɔnka no wɔn akoma mu
sɛ mekaa wɔn bɔneyɛ nyinaa;
afei wɔn nneyɛɛ atwa wɔn ho ahyia,
ɛgu m’anim.
3Wɔde wɔn bɔneyɛ ma ɔhene ani gye,
na wɔde wɔn atorosɛm yɛ mmapɔmma saa ara.
4Wɔn nyinaa yɛ awaresɛefoɔ,
te sɛ ɔfononoo a paanootoni
ahyɛ mu gya na ɔgyae mu pia
firi mmɔre feteɛ so kɔsi ne ka soɔ.
5 # Hos 4.11 Yɛn hene afahyɛ da mu no,
nsaborɔ bɔɔ mmapɔmma yadeɛ.
Ɔne afɛdifoɔ di nsawɔsoɔ.
6Na wɔasiesie wɔn akoma sɛ fononoo, wɔn atirisopam no mu.
Wɔn paanootoni da anadwo nyinaa,
anɔpa ɛdɛre sɛ ogya framfram.
7Wɔn nyinaa mu ayɛ hye sɛ fononoo,
na wɔdi wɔn atemmufoɔ nam;
wɔn ahemfo nyinaa totɔ.
Obi nni wɔn mu a ɔfrɛ me.
Efraim ne aman ntam asɛm
8Efraim de ne ho fra aman mu;
Efraim yɛ ɔfam a wɔankusa.
9Ahɔhoɔ adi n’ahoɔden,
nso ɔnnim;
ɛdwono nso ahura ne tirim,
nso ɔnnim.
10Na Israel ahantan di n’anim adanseɛ,
na wɔnsane mma AWURADE wɔn Nyankopɔn nkyɛn,
na wɔnhwehwɛ no yei nyinaa mu.
11 # Hos 5.13; 12.1 Na Efraim adane sɛ aburuburo,
ɔkwasea a ɔnni ti;
wɔrepɛ Misraim hɔ mmoa no, na wɔredan Asiria nso.
12Wɔrekorɔ no, mɛtrɛ me ntentan mu makata wɔn so;
mɛduru wɔn sɛ ewiem nnomaa;
mɛtwe wɔn aso, na wɔn asafo bɛte nka.
13 # Dwom 81.13-14 Wɔnnue, ɛfiri sɛ wɔadwane me;
ɔsɛeɛ mmra wɔn so, ɛfiri sɛ wɔato me mmara;
na me deɛ, anka mɛgye wɔn,
nanso wɔdi me ho torɔ.
14Na wɔnsu mfrɛɛ me wɔn akoma mu,
na wɔbobom wɔn, nnaeɛ so;
ayuo ne nsa nti na wɔdi nkyeresoɔ,
wɔte m’anim atua.
15Me deɛ, makyerɛkyerɛ, na mahyɛ wɔn basa mu den,
nanso ɛpɔ bɔne na wɔbɔ no me ho.
16 # Dwom 78.57 Wɔsane wɔn akyi, nanso wɔmma ɔsorosoroni#7.16 ƆSOROSORONI: Deɛ Hebri no ka no mu nna hɔ papa. no nkyɛn,
wɔayɛ sɛ tadua a agoɔ:
Afena ano na wɔn mmapɔmma bɛtotɔ,
nkeka a wɔn tɛkyerɛma yɛ nti;
yei bɛma wɔadi wɔn ho fɛw Misraim asase so.

Meresa Israel yadeɛ yi,
na Efraim amumuyɛ ne Samaria
nnebɔne reda adi;
na wɔdi atorɔ,
na owifoɔ bubu ba mu,
akwanmukafoɔ asafo nso fom fa wɔ mmorɔno so.
Na wɔnka no wɔn akoma mu
sɛ mekaa wɔn bɔneyɛ nyinaa;
afei wɔn nneyɛɛ atwa wɔn ho ahyia,
ɛgu m’anim.
Wɔde wɔn bɔneyɛ ma ɔhene ani gye,
na wɔde wɔn atorosɛm yɛ mmapɔmma saa ara.
Wɔn nyinaa yɛ awaresɛefoɔ,
te sɛ ɔfononoo a paanootoni
ahyɛ mu gya na ɔgyae mu pia
firi mmɔre feteɛ so kɔsi ne ka soɔ.
Yɛn hene afahyɛ da mu no,
nsaborɔ bɔɔ mmapɔmma yadeɛ.
Ɔne afɛdifoɔ di nsawɔsoɔ.
Na wɔasiesie wɔn akoma sɛ fononoo, wɔn atirisopam no mu.
Wɔn paanootoni da anadwo nyinaa,
anɔpa ɛdɛre sɛ ogya framfram.
Wɔn nyinaa mu ayɛ hye sɛ fononoo,
na wɔdi wɔn atemmufoɔ nam;
wɔn ahemfo nyinaa totɔ.
Obi nni wɔn mu a ɔfrɛ me.

Efraim de ne ho fra aman mu;
Efraim yɛ ɔfam a wɔankusa.
Ahɔhoɔ adi n’ahoɔden,
nso ɔnnim;
ɛdwono nso ahura ne tirim,
nso ɔnnim.
Na Israel ahantan di n’anim adanseɛ,
na wɔnsane mma AWURADE wɔn Nyankopɔn nkyɛn,
na wɔnhwehwɛ no yei nyinaa mu.
Na Efraim adane sɛ aburuburo,
ɔkwasea a ɔnni ti;
wɔrepɛ Misraim hɔ mmoa no, na wɔredan Asiria nso.
Wɔrekorɔ no, mɛtrɛ me ntentan mu makata wɔn so;
mɛduru wɔn sɛ ewiem nnomaa;
mɛtwe wɔn aso, na wɔn asafo bɛte nka.
Wɔnnue, ɛfiri sɛ wɔadwane me;
ɔsɛeɛ mmra wɔn so, ɛfiri sɛ wɔato me mmara;
na me deɛ, anka mɛgye wɔn,
nanso wɔdi me ho torɔ.
Na wɔnsu mfrɛɛ me wɔn akoma mu,
na wɔbobom wɔn, nnaeɛ so;
ayuo ne nsa nti na wɔdi nkyeresoɔ,
wɔte m’anim atua.
Me deɛ, makyerɛkyerɛ, na mahyɛ wɔn basa mu den,
nanso ɛpɔ bɔne na wɔbɔ no me ho.
Wɔsane wɔn akyi, nanso wɔmma ɔsorosoroni no nkyɛn,
wɔayɛ sɛ tadua a agoɔ:
Afena ano na wɔn mmapɔmma bɛtotɔ,
nkeka a wɔn tɛkyerɛma yɛ nti;
yei bɛma wɔadi wɔn ho fɛw Misraim asase so.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
